name: <<short project name, e.g. smith-2024; also the directory name under audits/>>
title: <<authors, 'title'; which results are in scope>>
source_pdf: <<path to the paper's .tex (preferred) or .pdf, absolute or relative to the Lean project root>>
source_id: <<e.g. arXiv:2401.01234v1, or a short id for an unpublished paper>>
source_cite: <<citation as it should appear in the report>>
branch: <<git branch of the Lean project that holds this run>>
base_commit: <<the commit the branch was created from>>
work_dir: <<persistent directory for helper drafts; default .formalization-work/<name> (inside the project, git-excluded); never under /tmp>>
blind_spots: <<what each Phase 0 check does not read, for this source (see AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md)>>
involvement: <<involved, statements-only or hands-off: the human's answer to intake question 5d (default involved)>>
involvement_answer: <<the human's answer to intake question 5d, verbatim ('default' if they took the default)>>
